summary: Baytex Energy Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing the schedule for its first quarter 2026 earnings release and a subsequent conference call and webcast on May 8, 2026. There is no disclosed transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, capital return, or any other special situation. This is a routine earnings announcement and investor event notice. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 with no deal terms or special-category event.
